caption: Erich Ludendorff (1865–1937) — as a staff officer at Liège on 7 August 1914 he drove to the citadel and took its surrender, then went east to Tannenberg as Hindenburg's chief of staff; by 1916 he ran the German war effort. Photographed in 1915. Colorized (AI-assisted).
